leadIn: By the end of this lesson, learners will be able to:
objectives: Define TypeScript interfaces to structure user authentication data including credentials and user profiles.
Implement HTTP request functions using fetch or axios to send login credentials to a backend API endpoint.
Apply cookie handling mechanisms to store authentication tokens received from server responses.
Utilize React state hooks to manage and update authentication status within components.
Execute conditional rendering to display different UI elements based on the user's authentication state.
Construct protected route components that check for authentication cookies before allowing access.
Handle form submission events to capture user credentials and trigger authentication requests.
Implement logout functionality to clear authentication cookies and reset application state.
Control component lifecycle by checking authentication status during initial component mounting.
Use environment variables to store and access API endpoint URLs for different deployment environments.
Apply error handling patterns to manage authentication failures and display user-friendly messages.
Modify HTTP request headers to include authentication tokens for subsequent API calls to protected endpoints.
